prose: Microsoft's Quicksand is an async Python library for launching, controlling and snapshotting QEMU virtual machines, aimed at sandboxing AI agents. It ships ready-made Ubuntu and Alpine images for x86_64 and ARM64 on macOS, Linux and Windows.
Sandboxes run without root or Docker. A short context-manager API lets code execute commands, take screenshots and type text in a desktop VM, which is what a computer-using agent needs.
highlights: Async Python API for QEMU VMs
Ubuntu and Alpine images, x86_64 and ARM64
Desktop mode with screenshots and typing
